# .rimignore — files and folders to exclude when uploading to the Steam Workshop # # The syntax is identical to GitHub's .gitignore: # # comment (\# for a literal hash) # !xxx re-include; later rules override earlier ones # /xxx anchored to the mod root # xxx/ directories only # * any characters, but never across / # ? a single character, but never across / # [abc] character set; [!abc] to negate # **/xxx at any depth; xxx/** for everything inside that folder # # Note: as in Git, once a directory is excluded its contents cannot be # re-included with !. # Always excluded by default: this file, .git/ .gitignore .gitattributes # .svn/ .hg/ .vs/ .idea/ .vscode/ # Thumbs.db desktop.ini .DS_Store # Those built-in rules can be overridden with !, e.g. !.rimignore uploads this file too.
# -- Source code and build output -- /_Sources/ /Source/ **/obj/ **/bin/ *.pdb *.csproj.user *.sln *.suo
# -- Unity project -- /UnityProject/
# -- Dev tools and shortcuts -- /_Tools/ *.lnk *.bat
# -- Editor and backup noise -- *.orig *.rej *.bak *~
# -- Example: exclude a folder's contents but keep one file -- # Exclude the *contents* rather than the folder itself, then re-include: # /Docs/* # !/Docs/Manual.md
